newsitem.title: INDIA: Fire guts airport terminal in Indian capital.
newsitem.headline: Fire guts airport terminal in Indian capital.

text.p: A fire destroyed a departure terminal at New Delhi's domestic airport on Wednesday, forcing authorities to close the airport temporarily, police said.
"A fire broke out in the Indian Airlines terminal at around 3:30 a.m. (2200 GMT on Tuesday) and completely destroyed the building," a police spokeswoman told Reuters.
No injuries were reported in the blaze, which broke out at the terminal on the outskirts of New Delhi, news agencies said.
State-owned Indian Airlines managing director P.C. Sen said it appeared to have started in a kitchen, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
About 30 fire trucks were sent to the airport. A second airport serving international flights is located nearby.
United News of India said the domestic airport was closed temporarily and flights scheduled to depart before 7 a.m. (0230 GMT) were cancelled.
Passengers taking Indian Airlines flights later in the day were to be routed through an adjacent terminal serving private local airlines.
Indian Airlines is the state-owned domestic carrier and Air-India the international airline.
